units.source_text: 且说夕雾大将对三公主，并非没有恋念之情。

en.t: Now, General Yugiri was not without feelings of longing for the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 如今三公主嫁到六条院来，住在近旁了，使他不能无动于衷。

en.t: Now that the Third Princess had married into the Rokujo estate and was living nearby, he could not remain unmoved.

units.source_text: 他便以寻常问候为借口，每逢适当机会，便到三公主居处侍候，其间自然窥见或听到了三公主的情状。

en.t: Using ordinary greetings as an excuse, he went to attend at the Third Princess's residence whenever a suitable chance arose, and in the course of this naturally glimpsed or heard about her circumstances.

units.source_text: 原来三公主年纪很小，而态度大模大样，外表威仪堂皇。

en.t: The Third Princess was in fact very young, yet her manner was grand and self-possessed, and outwardly she had a stately dignity.

units.source_text: 其养尊处优，可为世间表率，然而并无显著的优雅风度。

en.t: Her privileged upbringing could serve as a model for the world, yet she showed no especially striking grace or refinement.

units.source_text: 她身边的侍女，也少有老成持重之人，多数是青年美女，只爱好繁华生涯与风流情趣。

en.t: Among the gentlewomen around her, too, few were mature and steady; most were young beauties who cared only for a splendid life and romantic elegance.

units.source_text: 这无数侍女聚集在这里服侍她，她的香闺真可说是一处无忧无虑的乐土。

en.t: With these countless attendants gathered there to serve her, her perfumed chambers could truly be called a carefree paradise.

units.source_text: 但其中也有对万事都沉着镇静的人，只因心中之事不能表现于外，便怀着无人能知的悲愁，参与在无忧无虑、真心欢乐的人群中。

en.t: Yet among them were also some who remained calm and composed in all things; because they could not show what was in their hearts, they carried a grief no one could know while joining the crowd of carefree, sincerely joyful people.

units.source_text: 又被旁人诱惑，便和她们同化，亦作欢笑之颜。

en.t: Drawn on by those around them, they blended in with the others and put on smiling faces as well.

units.source_text: 最是那些女童，朝夕热衷于无聊的游戏，源氏看在眼里，颇感不快。

en.t: Most of all, the young girls were absorbed morning and evening in trivial games, and Genji, seeing this, felt rather displeased.

units.source_text: 但他的本性，对世事绝不固执己见，因此听任这些女童自由取乐，以为她们既然喜爱此种游戏，亦自深可原谅，故并不加以斥责或训诫。

en.t: But by nature he never clung stubbornly to his own opinions about worldly matters, so he let the girls amuse themselves freely, thinking that since they enjoyed such games they could well be forgiven, and therefore did not scold or lecture them.

units.source_text: 惟有对于三公主本人的举止言行，则十分用心教导，因此三公主也渐渐进步了。

en.t: Only with regard to the Third Princess's own conduct, speech, and manners did he teach her with great care, and so she too gradually improved.

units.source_text: 夕雾大将看到此种情状，想道：“世间完全无缺的女子，真正不易多得啊。

en.t: Seeing this state of affairs, General Yugiri thought, "Women who are wholly without flaw in this world are truly hard to find.

units.source_text: 只有那位紫夫人，不论在性情上或仪态上，多年以来，一向不曾被人看出或听到一点缺陷。

en.t: Only Lady Murasaki, whether in character or in bearing, has for many years never let anyone see or hear of the slightest defect.

units.source_text: 她的本质稳重沉着，心地温良。

en.t: Her nature is steady and composed, and her heart is gentle and kind.

units.source_text: 她不轻视别人，而自身又永保尊严，气度越发显得高超可爱。”

en.t: She does not look down on others, while always preserving her own dignity, and her bearing seems all the more noble and lovable."

units.source_text: 他那天窥见的面影便浮现在心头，难于忘怀了。

en.t: The image of the face he had glimpsed that day rose in his heart and became hard to forget.

units.source_text: 他回思自己的夫人云居雁，觉得爱情亦很深厚，然而此人毕竟缺乏那种可贵的、优雅的情趣。

en.t: Thinking back on his own wife, Kumoi no Kari, he felt that his love for her was also very deep, yet she lacked, after all, that precious and graceful charm.

units.source_text: 她那温柔驯良的风度，夕雾现已看惯，不复深感兴趣了。

en.t: Yugiri had now grown used to her gentle and compliant manner, and no longer felt any deep interest in it.

units.source_text: 但觉这六条院里聚集着许多女子，袅娜娉婷，各尽其美。

en.t: He felt instead that many women had gathered in the Rokujo estate, graceful and lovely, each displaying her own beauty to the fullest.

units.source_text: 他私下想象，艳羡之心难禁。

en.t: As he imagined them in private, he could hardly restrain his admiring envy.

units.source_text: 尤其是这位三公主，照她的高贵身份想来，应该受得父亲无限宠幸，然而父亲对她并无特别深切的爱情，只在人目所见的面子上表示重视。

en.t: In particular, considering the Third Princess's noble rank, she ought to have received limitless affection from her father, yet he felt no especially deep love for her and valued her only outwardly for the sake of appearances.

units.source_text: 夕雾有此感想，虽然不敢发生非礼之念，但总觉得三公主深可怜爱，指望有缘见她一面。

en.t: With these thoughts in mind, Yugiri did not dare entertain any improper desire, yet he still found the Third Princess deeply dear and pitiable, and hoped that fate might let him see her once.
